text: I can size a topic's partition count from peak throughput and per-consumer throughput, with headroom.
I can choose a partition key for a given ordering need and propose two fixes for a hot key, with their costs.
I can state exactly what ordering Kafka guarantees and name two ways a consumer can break it.
I can explain how consumer groups give queue behaviour within a group and pub/sub across groups, and why extra consumers can sit idle.
I can list what triggers a rebalance and three ways to make rebalances less disruptive.
I can calculate how long a lagging consumer group takes to catch up and explain why I'd alert on time lag.
